main_text.p: tumelia afficit pios Sacerdotes & prophetas qui ipsi quoque etsi ceremoniali defungeren-tur cultu, principaliter tamen ministri spiri-tus fuerunt.

Huc enim vero plurimum facit, venustissima illa imago, tradita a filio Dei, in qua prophetarum quidem ministerium & doctrina, sationi [?]: Apostolorum vero ministerium & doctrina, mesi [?] confertur: & dulcissima illorum consensio, velut religiosus quidam concentus, omnem Musicam harmoniam longissime superans, magnificè celebratur, his quidem verbis: Ego misi vos (Apostolos) ad id metendum in quo vos non laborastis: alij (patres videlicet, pij sacerdotes Leuitici & Prophetae) laborauerunt, & vos in labores eorum introistis. Ioan. 4.38.

Ideo & Petrus Apostolus, vt diserte o-stenderet, etiam Prophetas veteris testamen-ti, spiritus ministerio fideliter esse functos, hac memoria prodidit: Non voluntate homi-num allata est olim prophetia: sed acti a spi-ritu sancto loquuti sunt sancti Dei homines.

page.notes: Running head read as DE UNICO (printed VNICO). Page number at top left is hard to read; given as 222 with doubt. The word after "doctrina," (printed as a long s-like form, probably "salutationi" or "sationi") is doubtful. "mesi" after "mesi" is doubtful (possibly "mensi"). A decorative mark stands before "Musicam" and before "Apostolos"; not transcribed. Hyphens at line ends are printed where visible; "ministerium" and "dulcissima" have no printed hyphen.
